hammers.name: Rusty Hammer
hammers.desc: Old, bent and held together with tape. It works. Mostly.

hammers.name: Iron Hammer
hammers.desc: Solid iron, honest wood. A real builder's hammer.

hammers.name: Steel Hammer
hammers.desc: Polished steel with a comfy rubber grip.

hammers.name: Golden Hammer
hammers.desc: Solid gold. Every hit shines.

hammers.name: Titanium Sledge
hammers.desc: A double-faced sledge. Light as air, hard as rock.

hammers.name: Emerald Hammer
hammers.desc: A flawless emerald set in gold.

hammers.name: Ruby Hammer
hammers.desc: Two blazing rubies on a platinum core.

hammers.name: Sapphire War Hammer
hammers.desc: A sapphire war hammer with a deadly spike.

hammers.name: Amethyst Crystal Hammer
hammers.desc: Crystals that grew on their own. Glowing.

hammers.name: Lava Hammer
hammers.desc: Forged in a volcano. Still hot.

hammers.name: Frost Hammer
hammers.desc: Cold enough to freeze the air around it.

hammers.name: Diamond Hammer
hammers.desc: The hardest hammer there is. Rainbow sparkles included.

hammers.name: Plasma Hammer
hammers.desc: Pure energy, held in a magnetic field.

hammers.name: Solar Hammer
hammers.desc: A tiny sun on a stick. Do not look straight at it.

hammers.name: Galaxy Hammer
hammers.desc: A whole galaxy, trapped in crystal. The last hammer.

hammers.name: Thunderclap Hammer
hammers.desc: A storm in a hammer. Triples your build power, forever.

hammers.name: Carpenter's Mallet
hammers.desc: A fat wooden mallet with a leather-wrapped handle. Thud.

hammers.name: Brick Hammer
hammers.desc: A red brick on a stick. Don't ask how it holds together.

hammers.name: Claw Hammer
hammers.desc: The classic claw hammer, fresh from the hardware store.

hammers.name: Copper Pipe Hammer
hammers.desc: A plumber's revenge: a bent copper pipe, polished to a mirror.

hammers.name: Neon Hammer
hammers.desc: Black rubber with glowing neon stripes. Looks fast standing still.

hammers.name: Toolbox Hammer
hammers.desc: A whole red toolbox welded onto a handle. Everything you need, in one swing.

hammers.name: Bronze Mallet
hammers.desc: Ancient bronze with green patina. It has seen things.

hammers.name: Obsidian Hammer
hammers.desc: Black volcanic glass with a red glow deep inside.

hammers.name: Jade Hammer
hammers.desc: Carved green jade with golden dragon engravings.

hammers.name: Candy Hammer
hammers.desc: A giant swirl lollipop head on a candy-cane handle. Sticky.

hammers.name: Dragon Fang Hammer
hammers.desc: A dragon's fang bound in scales. It still breathes a little smoke.

hammers.name: Clockwork Hammer
hammers.desc: Brass gears spin inside the glass head with every swing.

hammers.name: Robo Hammer
hammers.desc: A white-and-blue robot head that beeps when it hits.

hammers.name: Phoenix Hammer
hammers.desc: Golden feathers and living flame. It rises with every swing.

hammers.name: Tsunami Hammer
hammers.desc: A frozen wave of deep blue water, white foam on the crest.

hammers.name: Cyber Hammer
hammers.desc: Matte black with cyan circuit lines that pulse to the beat.

hammers.name: Void Hammer
hammers.desc: A hole in the world shaped like a hammer. Light bends around it.

hammers.name: Black Hole Hammer
hammers.desc: An event horizon on a handle. Whatever it hits is gone.

hammers.name: Demon King Hammer
hammers.desc: Horns, chains and a crown of fire. Forged in the deep.

hammers.name: Celestial Creator
hammers.desc: White marble, gold and a halo of light. The hammer that built the sky.

hammers.name: Royal Crown Hammer
hammers.desc: A jewelled crown for a head, red velvet grip. Exclusive.

hammers.name: Ghost Hammer
hammers.desc: Translucent and glowing, with wisps trailing behind. Exclusive.

hammers.name: Rainbow Prism Hammer
hammers.desc: A crystal prism that splits every hit into a rainbow. Exclusive.

hammers.name: Founder's Hammer
hammers.desc: Only given during the launch event. Never again.
